journey.title: A new week
journey.purpose: Move to next week, carry forward locked anchors and credible stock, review a generated draft, apply it, and get the matching grocery list.

steps.intent: Move to the next week and see locks and anchors carried forward.
Generate a draft and review changed, unchanged, and locked slots.
Revalidate a draft whose inputs changed instead of applying it stale.
Open the new week's grocery list.

claims.statement: A generated draft never replaces an accepted plan without review.
